biography.plain_text: Barry Patterson was an Australian mining engineer who co-founded Eltin, JR Engineering and GR Engineering Services. After two decades with WMC Resources, he helped build businesses that managed mines and designed mineral-processing plants. He became GR Engineering's chairman when it listed and remained a director until his death in 2020.

long_biography.plain_text:
When mining entrepreneur Barry Patterson backed the struggling Sonic Healthcare, he wanted a pathologist to lead it. He told Colin Goldschmidt that specialists should run businesses in their own discipline. Goldschmidt accepted the chief executive's role despite having no formal business training, and developed Sonic's approach to medical leadership.

Patterson also maintained close ties with the Western Australian School of Mines. He mentored students and graduates, offered career opportunities and made financial contributions to the school. He had graduated there as a mining engineer. The alumni association recognised his contribution with its High Achiever Award.
